jobs.description:
About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

Summary Of Role

GlobalFoundries is seeking a Director of Advanced Packaging Development to lead the development and industrialization of advanced packaging solutions for next-generation silicon photonics and optical interconnect products. This leader will be responsible for driving internal packaging development activities while serving as the primary interface to external OSATs, suppliers, ecosystem partners, and key customers.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Product Line Management, Business Development, and engineering organizations to define packaging technology roadmaps, develop differentiated solutions, and enable commercialization of future products. This role requires a unique combination of technical leadership, team development, customer engagement, business partnership, and external ecosystem management.

Essential Responsibilities

Technical and Organizational Leadership

Lead the advanced packaging development organization responsible for package architecture, assembly processes, qualification strategy, manufacturing readiness, and product industrialization.
Build and develop a high-performing team focused on technical excellence, innovation, and execution.
Drive technology decisions related to package design, materials, thermal management, reliability, manufacturability, and cost optimization.
Establish development methodologies, design guidelines, and qualification strategies to support product scale-up and commercialization.

Roadmap and Strategy

Define and maintain the advanced packaging technology roadmap supporting silicon photonics, optical interconnect, co-packaged optics, AI networking, and future platform developments.
Align packaging investments and development priorities with product roadmaps, customer requirements, and business objectives.
Evaluate emerging technologies, market trends, and supplier capabilities to maintain GlobalFoundries' competitive position.
Drive strategic decisions on technology selection, capability development, and manufacturing approaches.

Customer and Business Engagement

Partner with Product Management and Business Development to shape future product and technology strategies.
Engage directly with customers to understand technology requirements, packaging challenges, and long-term roadmap needs.
Represent GlobalFoundries during customer technical reviews, roadmap discussions, executive briefings, and development engagements.
Support customer acquisition and growth initiatives by translating customer requirements into differentiated packaging solutions.
Build trusted relationships with customers, OSATs, suppliers, and ecosystem partners to accelerate business growth and technology adoption.

External Partner Management

Serve as the primary technical and business interface to OSATs, assembly partners, material suppliers, and strategic ecosystem collaborators.
Lead joint development activities with external partners to enable future product platforms.
Drive alignment on development schedules, technical milestones, qualification plans, and manufacturing readiness.
Develop scalable manufacturing and sourcing strategies supporting both development and high-volume production.

Program Execution

Lead cross-functional execution across design, process integration, reliability, product engineering, manufacturing, quality, procurement, and supply chain teams.
Identify and mitigate technical, schedule, cost, supply chain, and manufacturing risks.
Communicate program status, investment recommendations, and strategic priorities to senior leadership.
Ensure successful transition of packaging technologies from development into production.

Other Responsibilities

Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications

BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related discipline.
15+ years of experience in semiconductor packaging, advanced packaging, photonics packaging, or related technologies.
Demonstrated experience leading complex technology development organizations and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Strong knowledge of advanced packaging technologies including flip-chip assembly, wafer-level packaging, optical packaging, high-density interconnects, thermal management, and reliability qualification.
Experience working directly with OSATs, outsourced manufacturing partners, and semiconductor supply chains.
Proven ability to lead strategic customer engagements and external partnerships.
Excellent communication, leadership, and executive presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with silicon photonics, optical engines, optical interconnects, or co-packaged optics.
Experience supporting hyperscale, networking, telecommunications, AI, or datacenter applications.
Track record of building and scaling high-performing engineering organizations.
Experience managing technology roadmaps, strategic investments, and customer-facing development programs.

This position will provide end-to-end leadership for advanced packaging technology development, external manufacturing partnerships, customer engagement, and roadmap execution. Position Summary

The Director, Test Engineering is responsible for leading NetApp's PCBA Manufacturing Test Engineering organization, ensuring products are designed, validated, and manufactured to meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, manufacturability, and operational efficiency. This position leads the engineering team responsible for In-Circuit Test (ICT), Boundary Scan Test (BST), Functional Verification Test (FVT), and Environmental Stress Screening (ESS) across both New Product Introduction (NPI) programs and sustaining manufacturing operations.

Reporting directly to the VP, Ops Engineering, the Director will drive manufacturing test strategy, execution, automation, quality improvements, factory yield optimization, and continuous process improvement initiatives in partnership with engineering, operations, supply chain, and manufacturing partners worldwide.

The Director leads an organization consisting of one engineering manager and a total team of approximately eleven engineers located in San Jose, CA, Wichita, KS, and Taipei, Taiwan, while driving a portfolio of strategic initiatives focused on improving product quality, manufacturing efficiency, test coverage, cost, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the company's PCBA manufacturing test strategy across ICT, BST, FVT, and ESS.
Lead manufacturing test development and deployment for all NPI programs, ensuring test readiness, quality objectives, schedule commitments, and successful production ramps.
Drive continuous improvement of sustaining manufacturing test processes, methodologies, automation, coverage, efficiency, and factory yields.
Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization consisting of managers and individual contributors across multiple geographies.

Lead engagement with contract manufacturers, suppliers, and external engineering partners to ensure global manufacturing test excellence.
Drive a portfolio of continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational efficiency, quality improvement, manufacturing scalability, cost reduction, and test optimization.
Champion Design for Testability (DFT), Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and Design for Quality (DFQ) practices across product development programs.
Establish organizational roadmaps, budgets, staffing plans, and resource strategies aligned with business priorities.

Develop succession plans and organizational capability to support future business growth.
Foster strong cross-functional partnerships and influence decision-making across engineering and operations organizations.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.

Strong expertise in PCBA manufacturing test methodologies, including ICT, BST, FVT, and ESS.
Experience supporting both New Product Introduction (NPI) programs and sustaining manufacturing operations.
Demonstrated success driving manufacturing quality, yield improvement, defect reduction, and operational excellence initiatives.
Experience working with global manufacturing partners, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional engineering organizations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.
Excellent verbal, written, and executive communication skills.

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience with enterprise storage systems, networking products, server platforms, or other complex electronic systems.
Experience implementing manufacturing test automation, data analytics, and advanced diagnostic methodologies.
Proven track record of leading large-scale engineering transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.
Lean, Six Sigma, or related continuous improvement certification.

Successful delivery of manufacturing test solutions for all NPI programs.
Sustained improvements in factory yield, quality, test coverage, efficiency, and cost.
Execution of strategic test engineering improvement initiatives.

This is a senior railroad operating and maintenance leadership position with direct responsibility for the safety, inspection, testing, maintenance, repair, reliability, regulatory compliance, and state of good repair of NICTD Engineering Department infrastructure, including Track, Structures, Line, and Signal. The Chief Engineering Officer leads NICTD's Engineering Department and is expected to be a visible, handson field leader. The successful candidate will establish clear standards, enforce railroad operating and safety rules consistently, develop supervisors and employees, identify infrastructure risks before they become failures, and ensure that work is properly planned, documented, and executed.

With safety at the front of mind, the Chief Engineering Officer is accountable for the safe condition and regulatory compliance of infrastructure under the Engineering Department's control and for building a department in which employees understand that production, schedule, and cost never take priority over safe work practices, regulatory compliance, accurate inspection and testing, and safe railroad operations.

The Chief Engineering Officer works closely with the Senior Director of Capital Projects and Structures. The Chief Engineering Officer remains accountable for the safe condition, inspection, maintenance, repair, and operational availability of Engineering Department assets, while the Senior Director provides senior structural technical expertise and leads assigned major capital rehabilitation, replacement, and construction projects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Safety Leadership
• Provide visible, hands-on safety leadership for the Engineering Department, including regular field observations, work-site visits, job briefing observations, and infrastructure inspections.
• Establish and maintain a culture in which safe work practices, operating discipline, regulatory compliance, accurate reporting, and prompt correction of hazards are expected every day.
• Ensure employees and contractors comply with NICTD safety rules, applicable FRA regulations, Roadway Worker Protection requirements, Track Safety Standards, bridge worker safety requirements, and other applicable requirements.
• Ensure employees have the training, qualifications, tools, equipment, personal protective equipment, and supervision necessary to perform work safely.
• Review employee injuries, near misses, infrastructure failures, derailments, rule violations, and significant operating events involving Engineering; identify root causes and ensure corrective actions are implemented and closed.
• Ensure reported hazards and safety concerns are evaluated promptly, and corrective actions are tracked to completion.
• Exercise authority to stop or restrict work, impose appropriate operating restrictions, increase inspection or monitoring, or remove infrastructure from service when conditions warrant.
Report significant safety, regulatory, infrastructure, and service risks promptly and accurately to executive leadership.
• Work closely with NICTD Safety and Transportation leadership to improve employee safety, infrastructure safety, and railroad operating safety.

Track and Right-of-Way
• Direct the inspection, maintenance, repair, rehabilitation, and renewal of NICTD track and related right-of-way infrastructure.
• Ensure compliance with 49 CFR Part 213 - Track Safety Standards, applicable NICTD standards, and accepted railroad engineering practices.
• Ensure required inspections are properly performed, accurately documented, appropriately reviewed, and followed by timely corrective action.
• Establish maintenance priorities based on safety risk, asset condition, operating requirements, inspection findings, failure history, and available resources.
• Monitor track geometry, rail condition, switches, turnouts, roadbed, drainage, crossings, and related infrastructure for conditions affecting safety, reliability, ride quality, or train performance.
• Develop preventive and predictive maintenance practices intended to identify deterioration before it results in unsafe conditions or service disruption.
• Establish appropriate slow orders or other operating restrictions when required and aggressively manage corrective work necessary to safely remove restrictions.
• Plan and direct seasonal infrastructure programs and preparations for winter, extreme heat, drainage events, severe weather, vegetation, and other conditions affecting railroad infrastructure.
• Coordinate maintenance and construction activities with Transportation and other departments to minimize unnecessary service impacts while maintaining safety as the controlling priority.

Line and Signal
• Direct the safe inspection, testing, maintenance, repair, reliability, and state of good repair of NICTD signal systems, highway-rail grade crossing warning systems, and line infrastructure assigned to the Engineering Department.
• Ensure compliance with applicable requirements of 49 CFR Parts 234 and 236, NICTD standards, manufacturer requirements, and accepted railroad signal and communications practices.
• Ensure required signal and grade-crossing inspections, tests, records, and reports are completed accurately, reviewed appropriately, retained as required, and followed by timely corrective action.
• Establish preventive and corrective maintenance programs for signal, crossing-warning, and line assets based on safety risk, regulatory requirements, failure history, asset condition, service reliability, and lifecycle needs.
• Monitor signal failures, crossing-warning activations and failures, trouble calls, repeat defects, and other performance indicators; identify root causes and ensure effective corrective actions are implemented.
• Ensure Signal and Line employees are properly trained, qualified, equipped, and supervised to perform assigned work safely and in compliance with applicable regulations and NICTD requirements. • Coordinate signal and line outages, testing, cutovers, temporary arrangements, and maintenance activities with Transportation and other affected departments to protect railroad operations and minimize unnecessary service impacts.
Maintain appropriate emergency-response capability for signal failures, crossing-warning system failures, storm damage, utility interruptions, and other conditions affecting safe railroad operations.
• Work closely with the Senior Director of Capital Projects and Structures on capital projects affecting signal, crossing, line, and related Engineering Department assets. The Chief Engineering Officer retains responsibility for the safe operation, inspection, maintenance, and regulatory compliance of those assets following turnover.
• Participate in design, constructability, maintainability, testing, commissioning, acceptance, and turnover reviews for capital projects affecting Line and Signal systems.

Bridges and Structures
• Maintain departmental responsibility for the safe condition, inspection, maintenance, repair, and operational availability of NICTD bridges, culverts, retaining structures, and other structures assigned to the Engineering Department.
• Ensure bridge inspection and management activities comply with applicable FRA bridge safety requirements, NICTD policies, and accepted railroad engineering practices.
• Ensure structural defects and deficiencies are documented, evaluated, prioritized, monitored, and corrected within appropriate timeframes.
• Implement operating restrictions, increased inspection frequency, monitoring, temporary repairs, or removal from service when structural conditions require immediate action.
• Work closely with the Senior Director of Capital Projects and Structures to evaluate significant structural conditions, develop repair and rehabilitation strategies, establish capital priorities, and plan major bridge and structural improvements.
• Jointly evaluate significant structural deficiencies with the Senior Director. The Chief Engineering Officer retains responsibility for immediate safe operation and maintenance of the railroad; the Senior Director provides senior structural technical and capital-project expertise.
• Provide maintenance history, inspection findings, operational requirements, and field knowledge needed to develop and execute bridge and structural capital projects.
• Participate in design, constructability, maintainability, testing, commissioning, and acceptance reviews for capital projects affecting Engineering Department assets.
• Coordinate Engineering Department participation in assigned capital projects without transferring supervision of Engineering Department employees to the Senior Director.
• Coordinate with the Senior Director to ensure appropriate inspection, testing, as-built documentation, training, spare materials, warranties, and other turnover requirements are satisfied before completed assets enter routine Engineering Department maintenance.

Please visit our website for further job description details.

Salary and Benefits:
The annual salary is $159,650. Credit for time served in other railroad employment, including military leaves, will be applied in determining vacation day entitlements. Benefits include paid vacation, paid holidays, health club stipend, comp time, medical benefits, dental and vision benefits, health savings account, Railroad Retirement benefits, professional development and executive leadership opportunities, supplemental pension, and other competitive employee benefits.

JOB SUMMARY
Baylor Genetics is seeking a Senior Director of Software Engineering to lead the Bioinformatics Software Engineering team and drive the strategy, architecture, delivery, and operational support of production-grade software platforms that enable clinical genomic diagnostics. This leader will be accountable for building and guiding a high-performing software engineering organization that develops scalable, reliable, validated, and maintainable systems supporting Baylor Genetics’ clinical laboratory, bioinformatics, data, and reporting operations.
This role provides senior technical and people leadership across software engineering, clinical bioinformatics workflow implementation, data integration, platform modernization, and production support. The Senior Director will set engineering priorities, establish standards for software quality and delivery, and ensure that scientific innovation, regulatory expectations, and business needs are translated into secure, efficient, and sustainable software solutions.
The Senior Director will partner closely with R&D, clinical laboratory, quality, operations, product, and executive stakeholders to define technical roadmaps, manage delivery commitments, and ensure production systems meet the reliability, scalability, traceability, and compliance needs of a genomic diagnostics organization. This includes overseeing the transition of research methods and analytical prototypes into validated production workflows, modernizing legacy systems, strengthening software development lifecycle practices, and improving automation, documentation, and release management across the team.
Success in this role requires a seasoned engineering leader with strong software architecture judgment, practical knowledge of bioinformatics and clinical genomics workflows, experience leading software teams in regulated or quality-controlled environments, and the ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on technical oversight. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative, accountable, and execution-oriented leader who can mentor managers and engineers, promote engineering excellence, and deliver software capabilities that advance Baylor Genetics’ diagnostic services and long-term technology strategy.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Software Engineering Strategy and Leadership:
o Define and own the software engineering vision, technical roadmap, delivery priorities, and operating model for the Bioinformatics Software Engineering team in alignment with Baylor Genetics’ clinical, scientific, operational, and business objectives.
o Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of software engineers, bioinformatics engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
o Establish team goals, resource plans, delivery commitments, performance expectations for critical software engineering capabilities.
o Represent software engineering priorities, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Clinical Genomics Platform Delivery and Production Operations:
o Oversee the design, development, implementation, maintenance, and operational support of production-grade software platforms, bioinformatics workflows, data systems, and reporting solutions that enable clinical genomic diagnostics.
o Ensure production systems are scalable, reliable, secure, observable, validated, well-documented, and maintainable in a clinical laboratory and quality-controlled environment.
o Drive modernization of legacy systems, workflow orchestration, automation, containerization, cloud or HPC-based compute strategies, data integration, and software architecture to improve performance, reliability, and long-term sustainability.
o Establish operational support models, escalation processes, incident response practices, root-cause analysis expectations, and post-release monitoring for critical software and bioinformatics systems.
• Cross-Functional Partnership and Delivery Execution:
o Partner with R&D, clinical laboratory, quality, operations, product, data, and executive stakeholders to translate scientific innovation, clinical needs, and business priorities into actionable software roadmaps and delivery plans.
o Lead prioritization, scope definition, dependency management, timeline planning, and delivery governance for software initiatives that support new test launches, assay improvements, workflow enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
o Guide the transition of research algorithms, analytical prototypes, scripts, and proof-of-concept tools into validated, production-ready software components and workflows.
o Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
• Software Quality, Compliance, and Release Governance:
o Define and enforce software development lifecycle standards, including requirements management, architecture review, code review, version control, automated testing, validation support, documentation, deployment readiness, and release management.
o Ensure software engineering practices support applicable quality, regulatory, privacy, security, traceability, and audit-readiness expectations for clinical genomics and diagnostic testing environments.
o Establish metrics and governance mechanisms to monitor software quality, delivery performance, system reliability, production incidents, technical debt, and continuous improvement opportunities.
o Promote engineering practices that improve reproducibility, maintainability, automation, observability, and long-term operational resilience.

• AI-Enabled Engineering and Workflow Innovation:
o Lead responsible exploration and implementation of AI-enabled software engineering, workflow automation, decision-support, documentation, code assistance, issue triage, and operational support capabilities where they improve quality, efficiency, and scalability.
o Establish appropriate governance, human oversight, privacy safeguards, traceability, and reliability standards for AI-assisted tools used in software development, bioinformatics workflows, and operational processes.
o Promote adoption of AI-enabled practices that improve engineering productivity while maintaining clinical-grade quality, compliance, and accountability.
QUALIFICATIONS
Required
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Data Science, or a related quantitative or technical field.
• 12+ years of experience in software engineering, bioinformatics software development, clinical genomics technology, data platform development, or related computational technology roles.
• 7+ years of experience leading software engineering teams, including direct people management, performance management, mentoring, hiring, organizational planning, and management of technical leads or managers.

• Experience establishing or improving engineering standards for requirements management, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, validation support, documentation, release management, incident management, and production support.
• Practical understanding of NGS data, clinical genomics workflows, bioinformatics pipelines, genomic data formats, variant analysis workflows, laboratory interfaces, or diagnostic reporting systems.
• Experience translating research prototypes, analytical methods, scripts, or proof-of-concept tools into scalable, tested, validated, documented, and maintainable production workflows.
• Experience working with quality, regulatory, privacy, security, traceability, and audit-readiness expectations in clinical diagnostics, healthcare technology, laboratory operations, or other regulated software environments.
• Strong technical fluency in software engineering tools and practices, including Git-based development, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, Linux environments, containerization, workflow orchestration, cloud or HPC compute, databases, APIs, and monitoring or observability tools.
• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts, delivery risks, architectural tradeoffs, and operational priorities clearly to executive, technical, scientific, clinical, quality, and business stakeholders.

Location:
Overland Park, Kansas

: Salaried Exempt

Virtus Insurance, a nine-time Best Places to Work in Insurance award‑winner, is redefining what a modern brokerage looks like. We are fast, specialized, and relentlessly client‑centric, operating across Hospitality, Real Estate, Private Capital, Benefits, Construction, Retail & Distribution, Food & Beverage and Small Business / Personal Lines. Our culture rewards ownership, excellence, and fearless pursuit.

We are looking for a builder who wants to create the technology foundation that will power the next chapter of Virtus.

What This Role Is:

The Senior Manager, AI Engineering & Platform is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the technology infrastructure that supports Virtus' long-term AI and operational strategy.

This is not a role that begins with a blank page. Virtus already has internally built applications running in production and in daily use by our client success teams, and our enterprise data platform is under active construction with an external analytics partner. Our Chief Executive Officer has committed the firm to becoming fully AI-enabled, and the operations leadership accountable for that commitment builds with agentic tooling every day.

As the first dedicated engineering hire at Virtus, you will be the person who makes that work durable. This is a hands-on building role: you will write and ship production code, not solely review the work of others. The architecture, standards, and platforms you establish in your first year will support everything the firm builds after it.

This is a role for someone who wants to build, lead, and leave a lasting mark, with the autonomy to shape the technology platforms that will power Virtus' next decade of growth.

Who Thrives at Virtus:

Embody the Virtus Core Values: Better Tomorrow, Fearless Pursuit, and One Virtus
Are energized by building innovative technology solutions and solving complex business challenges
Design, develop, and support scalable applications with confidence and technical expertise
Are disciplined operators who value architecture, security, quality, and measurable results
Communicate with clarity, credibility, and executive presence
Embrace ownership and accountability for the systems and platforms they build
Want a seat at the table to help shape the future of technology and AI at Virtus

Key Responsibilities:

Data Platform Ownership

Serve as Virtus' primary technical liaison for the firm's external data platform and analytics partners
Develop technical requirements, evaluate architecture and data models, and provide oversight of vendor-delivered solutions
Ensure data warehouse structures support operational applications, reporting needs, and future AI initiatives
Conduct technical reviews and acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet Virtus standards for quality, scalability, and business value
Partner with vendors and business stakeholders to support the long-term evolution of the firm's data platform

API & Integration Architecture

Design, build, and maintain a Virtus-owned API layer that serves as the primary integration point between enterprise data sources and internal applications
Establish integration standards that promote system stability, scalability, security, and maintainability
Ensure applications are architected to operate independently from vendor-managed data environments
Provide ongoing governance and oversight of enterprise integration strategies

Knowledge Management & AI Enablement

Design and maintain the technical architecture supporting Virtus' enterprise knowledge management strategy
Develop scalable solutions that enable structured, machine-readable access to organizational content, including standard operating procedures, training materials, and business documentation
Build and maintain retrieval and context-layer capabilities that support AI-powered applications and workflows
Ensure knowledge assets are organized and accessible to support future automation and AI initiatives

Application Development & Platform Engineering

Lead the design, development, and deployment of strategic internal business applications
Develop scalable platform standards for authentication, deployment, monitoring, backup, and system reliability
Serve as the primary technical owner for complex application initiatives, including automation and AI-powered solutions
Ensure all systems are built to support long-term operational stability, scalability, and business growth
Establish development practices that enable rapid innovation while maintaining security and governance standards

Technical Leadership & Architecture Oversight

Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across the organization's technology portfolio
Review proposed solutions to identify scalability, security, performance, and operational risks
Partner closely with Operations Leadership to evaluate technology investments and implementation strategies
Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology architecture, platform strategy, and long-term system evolution
Promote sound engineering practices and ensure technology decisions align with the organization's growth objectives

Qualifications:

Five or more years of engineering experience with demonstrated range across full-stack application development and data engineering, including the ability to review data warehouse designs and identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement
Experience serving as one of the first engineering hires within a growing organization or owning end-to-end production systems in an environment that required a high degree of autonomy and accountability
Python, SQL, and TypeScript as working languages
Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and supporting solutions in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure. Experience with AWS or Google Cloud Platform is acceptable with the ability to quickly become proficient in Azure
Demonstrated daily use of AI-assisted software development tools and large language model technologies, including practical application in coding, testing, debugging, and solution delivery. Agentic development tools should be a primary part of how you work rather than general familiarity. The interview process includes a live build session using these tools
Ability to independently deploy, monitor, support, and maintain production systems throughout the full software lifecycle
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for business stakeholders, including executive leadership

What Will Make You Stand Out:

Experience serving as the primary business stakeholder or technical lead in outsourced technology or vendor relationships, with the ability to evaluate technical deliverables, provide architectural feedback, and hold partners accountable to established standards
Experience working within highly regulated industries such as insurance, financial services, healthcare, or other environments where data security, privacy, and compliance are critical
Experience integrating enterprise systems and platforms, including agency management systems, CRM platforms, ERP systems, EHRs, or other systems of record through APIs, data exports, and related integration methods
Demonstrated ability to evaluate, prioritize, and apply artificial intelligence technologies in practical business settings, with sound judgment regarding where AI creates value and where traditional approaches are more effective

Physical Requirements:

The employee must be able to sit, use hands to handle or feel, talk or hear frequently; and occasionally stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. Must have close and distance vision.

Travel
:

This role requires minimal travel.

Virtus offers the freedom and trust to build a world‑class practice within a supportive, high‑performance environment. We invest in our people through:

Market-leading compensation and bonus programs
401(k)
Health, dental, and vision
Unlimited PTO
Continuous professional development
An entrepreneurial culture where great ideas become reality

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

We are looking for a Chief Engineer to join our rapidly growing space team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you will serve as the technical lead on a wide berth of emerging developments geared towards high-impact spacecraft missions focused on dynamic space operations, space control, and Rendezvous & Proximity Operations (RPO). Drawing on a strong technical background in space vehicle design, payload design and payload integration, you will drive technology developments through design, build, test, and delivery for on-orbit operations. Anduril is developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our U.S. military and allied partners maintain a decisive advantage in this contested war-fighting domain.

The Chief Engineer will develop a technical strategy and roadmap in conjunction with the Director of Engineering for Space Missions and the Growth/Strategy leads of the Space team that effectively leverages current Anduril technologies and newly developed technologies to serve customer mission areas. This role will address pre-award demonstrations, early contract phases, and full-contract execution. Working with a multi-disciplinary engineering team, the Chief Engineer will ensure the efficient development and delivery of hardware and software solutions for the customer.

These efforts will include leading complex, integrated systems for on-orbit operations and demonstrations to include subcontracted teammates and strategic partnerships. The Chief Engineer will facilitate effective technical development and integration that spans company boundaries in an agile development approach within a continuous integration/continuous deployment paradigm. They will balance the development of new capabilities with the incorporation of pre-existing Anduril or industry capabilities and effectively communicate technical progress to internal and external stakeholders.

The Chief Engineer will be responsible for technical oversight of all aspects of program execution from proposals to SRR, PDR, CDR, MRR, TRR, assembly, qualification testing, and delivery of flight units for launch. In conjunction with the Director of Engineering for Space Missions, they will assist in building out the necessary infrastructure to execute on all aspects of satellite and mission payload build, integration, and test—including establishing test requirements and pass/fail criteria with external vendors. The Chief Engineer will also work closely with the Anduril Space C2 team to enable and deliver Space Ground C2 products to both the customer and broader customer ecosystems. A successful Chief Engineer in the Space business line is one that is technically broad and can serve as an effective technical oversight for all disciplines across all phases of a program lifecycle, including: mechanical, thermal, structural, electrical, orbital software, ground software, FPGA, firmware, GNC, survivability, EMI/EMC, reliability, manufacturing (integration and test), and on-orbit operations.

What You’ll Do

Provide technical leadership and system-level expertise across spacecraft bus subsystems, specialized payload suites, and ground segments.
Serve as the technical authority on the program and maintain the technical integrity of the program. Monitor, control, and execute the engineering baseline of the program, and act in concert with the Program Manager to ensure that technical scope is both appropriate for the mission and satisfies end-customer needs.
Lead technical execution and architecture development for key mission areas, including Space Control and dynamic RPO missions.
Drive the engineering lifecycle for space vehicles and mission payloads from early architecture trades through flight hardware delivery and on-orbit commissioning.
Leverage strategic partnerships and teammates to build out new products that satisfy customer requirements in contested and challenging mission environments.
Provide space industry expertise to refine and advance the Anduril Space portfolio and strategy for customer engagements and demonstrations.
Contribute technical inputs and engineering execution plans to high-priority proposals.
Provide technical mentorship and oversight to a multi-disciplinary engineering team through all phases of program execution up to and including on-orbit operations.
Perform mission- and system-level trade studies and analysis to balance risk, cost, schedule, and mission performance.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated track record architecting, developing, and delivering defense/IC satellite systems, with hands-on heritage in space vehicle design and payload architecture/integration.
Deep domain expertise in Space Domain Awareness (SDA), Space Control, Rendezvous & Proximity Operations (RPO), and dynamic space operations.
Technical familiarity with high-dV spacecraft architectures, closed-loop relative navigation/GNC, and space-based sensing payloads (e.g., optical/IR/RF suites) across multiple orbital regimes (LEO, GEO, cislunar).
Strong understanding of the current technical state, mission needs, and CONOPS of key USSF and IC space enterprise systems.
Demonstrated ability to decompose complex mission requirements with competing constraints (e.g., SWaP-C, performance, schedule, modularity, cybersecurity, MLS) into executable engineering roadmaps.
Experience with standard space qualification and acceptance testing methodologies (e.g., SMC-S-016 / MIL-STD-1540, GEVS).
Strong technical fundamentals across space vehicle bus subsystems, payload interfaces, space ground infrastructure, and rapid product development.
Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to present critical briefings, trade studies, and program milestones to executive leadership and government customers.
Proven technical leadership experience on US Government / DoD / IC space contracts.
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

US Salary Range

$253,000—$336,000 USD

Benefits

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. Virtus Insurance, a nine-time Best Places to Work in Insurance award‑winner, is redefining what a modern brokerage looks like. We are fast, specialized, and relentlessly client‑centric, operating across Hospitality, Real Estate, Private Capital, Benefits, Construction, Retail & Distribution, Food & Beverage and Small Business / Personal Lines. Our culture rewards ownership, excellence, and fearless pursuit.

We are looking for a builder who wants to create the technology foundation that will power the next chapter of Virtus.

What This Role Is:

The Senior Manager, AI Engineering & Platform is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the technology infrastructure that supports Virtus' long-term AI and operational strategy.

This is not a role that begins with a blank page. Virtus already has internally built applications running in production and in daily use by our client success teams, and our enterprise data platform is under active construction with an external analytics partner. Our Chief Executive Officer has committed the firm to becoming fully AI-enabled, and the operations leadership accountable for that commitment builds with agentic tooling every day.

As the first dedicated engineering hire at Virtus, you will be the person who makes that work durable. This is a hands-on building role: you will write and ship production code, not solely review the work of others. The architecture, standards, and platforms you establish in your first year will support everything the firm builds after it.

This is a role for someone who wants to build, lead, and leave a lasting mark, with the autonomy to shape the technology platforms that will power Virtus' next decade of growth.

Who Thrives at Virtus:

Embody the Virtus Core Values: Better Tomorrow, Fearless Pursuit, and One Virtus
Are energized by building innovative technology solutions and solving complex business challenges
Design, develop, and support scalable applications with confidence and technical expertise
Are disciplined operators who value architecture, security, quality, and measurable results
Communicate with clarity, credibility, and executive presence
Embrace ownership and accountability for the systems and platforms they build
Want a seat at the table to help shape the future of technology and AI at Virtus

Key Responsibilities:

Data Platform Ownership

Serve as Virtus' primary technical liaison for the firm's external data platform and analytics partners
Develop technical requirements, evaluate architecture and data models, and provide oversight of vendor-delivered solutions
Ensure data warehouse structures support operational applications, reporting needs, and future AI initiatives
Conduct technical reviews and acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet Virtus standards for quality, scalability, and business value
Partner with vendors and business stakeholders to support the long-term evolution of the firm's data platform

API & Integration Architecture

Design, build, and maintain a Virtus-owned API layer that serves as the primary integration point between enterprise data sources and internal applications
Establish integration standards that promote system stability, scalability, security, and maintainability
Ensure applications are architected to operate independently from vendor-managed data environments
Provide ongoing governance and oversight of enterprise integration strategies

Knowledge Management & AI Enablement

Design and maintain the technical architecture supporting Virtus' enterprise knowledge management strategy
Develop scalable solutions that enable structured, machine-readable access to organizational content, including standard operating procedures, training materials, and business documentation
Build and maintain retrieval and context-layer capabilities that support AI-powered applications and workflows
Ensure knowledge assets are organized and accessible to support future automation and AI initiatives

Application Development & Platform Engineering

Lead the design, development, and deployment of strategic internal business applications
Develop scalable platform standards for authentication, deployment, monitoring, backup, and system reliability
Serve as the primary technical owner for complex application initiatives, including automation and AI-powered solutions
Ensure all systems are built to support long-term operational stability, scalability, and business growth
Establish development practices that enable rapid innovation while maintaining security and governance standards

Technical Leadership & Architecture Oversight

Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across the organization's technology portfolio
Review proposed solutions to identify scalability, security, performance, and operational risks
Partner closely with Operations Leadership to evaluate technology investments and implementation strategies
Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology architecture, platform strategy, and long-term system evolution
Promote sound engineering practices and ensure technology decisions align with the organization's growth objectives

Qualifications:

Five or more years of engineering experience with demonstrated range across full-stack application development and data engineering, including the ability to review data warehouse designs and identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement
Experience serving as one of the first engineering hires within a growing organization or owning end-to-end production systems in an environment that required a high degree of autonomy and accountability
Python, SQL, and TypeScript as working languages
Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and supporting solutions in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure. Experience with AWS or Google Cloud Platform is acceptable with the ability to quickly become proficient in Azure
Demonstrated daily use of AI-assisted software development tools and large language model technologies, including practical application in coding, testing, debugging, and solution delivery. Agentic development tools should be a primary part of how you work rather than general familiarity. The interview process includes a live build session using these tools
Ability to independently deploy, monitor, support, and maintain production systems throughout the full software lifecycle
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for business stakeholders, including executive leadership

What Will Make You Stand Out:

Experience serving as the primary business stakeholder or technical lead in outsourced technology or vendor relationships, with the ability to evaluate technical deliverables, provide architectural feedback, and hold partners accountable to established standards
Experience working within highly regulated industries such as insurance, financial services, healthcare, or other environments where data security, privacy, and compliance are critical
Experience integrating enterprise systems and platforms, including agency management systems, CRM platforms, ERP systems, EHRs, or other systems of record through APIs, data exports, and related integration methods
Demonstrated ability to evaluate, prioritize, and apply artificial intelligence technologies in practical business settings, with sound judgment regarding where AI creates value and where traditional approaches are more effective

Physical Requirements:

The employee must be able to sit, use hands to handle or feel, talk or hear frequently; and occasionally stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. Must have close and distance vision.

Travel
:

This role requires minimal travel.

Market-leading compensation and bonus programs
401(k)
Health, dental, and vision
Unlimited PTO

An upscale, select service hotel
is seeking an experienced and technically strong Director of Engineering
to oversee the property's engineering, maintenance, and building operations.
The Director of Engineering will be responsible for the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of all hotel physical plant systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, life-safety, building automation, and preventative maintenance systems
.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering leader with significant hotel engineering experience and strong HVAC expertise
. This individual must understand the operational demands of a luxury hotel and be capable of leading a skilled engineering team while maintaining exceptional guest comfort, safety, and property standards.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering & Building Operations
Direct all engineering and maintenance operations for the hotel.
Ensure reliable operation and maintenance of all building systems and equipment.
Maintain responsibility for HVAC, electrical, plumbing, boilers, chillers, pumps, generators, refrigeration, elevators, and mechanical systems
.
Oversee building automation and energy management systems.
Ensure guest rooms, public areas, restaurants, meeting spaces, back-of-house areas, and mechanical spaces are maintained to the highest standards.
Respond promptly to engineering emergencies and operational issues.

HVAC Leadership
Provide direct oversight of all hotel HVAC systems and related mechanical equipment.
Diagnose and troubleshoot HVAC issues and coordinate repairs as necessary.
Manage preventative maintenance programs for chillers, boilers, air handlers, cooling towers, pumps, compressors, and associated equipment.
Monitor temperature, humidity, ventilation, and indoor air quality throughout the property.
Ensure guest comfort and consistent climate control across guest rooms and public spaces.
Maintain appropriate relationships with HVAC contractors, service providers, and equipment vendors.
Develop strategies to improve HVAC reliability, efficiency, and energy performance.

Preventative Maintenance
Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive preventative maintenance program.
Establish maintenance schedules for all major hotel systems and equipment.
Monitor completion of preventative maintenance work orders.
Identify potential equipment failures before they impact guests or hotel operations.
Maintain accurate engineering records, service histories, inspections, and warranties.
Utilize CMMS or computerized maintenance systems effectively.

Team Leadership
Recruit, train, lead, and develop the hotel's engineering team.
Establish clear performance expectations and departmental standards.
Schedule engineering staff to provide appropriate coverage across all shifts.
Provide ongoing technical and safety training.
Coach and mentor Engineering Managers, Supervisors, and technicians.
Promote a culture of accountability, responsiveness, teamwork, and professionalism.

Capital Projects & Renovations
Partner with hotel leadership on capital improvement projects, renovations, and property enhancements.
Assist with project planning, budgeting, vendor selection, and execution.
Review engineering plans and specifications for new construction and renovations.
Ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, and within budget.
Maintain minimal disruption to guests and hotel operations during construction.

Financial Management
Develop and manage the Engineering department's annual operating and capital budgets.
Monitor departmental expenses and identify cost-saving opportunities.
Manage labor costs and staffing levels.
Evaluate vendor contracts and service agreements.
Develop energy conservation strategies to reduce operating costs.
Track utility consumption and identify opportunities for improved efficiency.

Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with all local, state, and federal building, fire, environmental, and safety regulations.
Maintain all required permits, inspections, licenses, and certifications.
Ensure fire/life-safety systems are properly maintained and tested.
Partner with Risk Management and Security on emergency preparedness.
Develop and maintain emergency response procedures.
Ensure OSHA and workplace safety standards are followed.

Luxury Guest Experience
Maintain a proactive approach to engineering issues that could affect guest satisfaction.
Respond immediately to guest-impacting maintenance concerns.
Partner with Rooms, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, and Front Office leadership to resolve operational issues.
Conduct regular property inspections to identify maintenance and appearance concerns.
Ensure the physical condition of the hotel reflects luxury brand standards.

Required
Minimum 7 years of progressive hotel engineering or facilities experience
.
Hotel experience is required.

Previous experience as a Director of Engineering, Chief Engineer, Assistant Director or Engineering Manager within a full-service hotel
.
Strong HVAC experience is required.

Demonstrated knowledge of commercial HVAC and mechanical systems.
Strong understanding of electrical, plumbing, boilers, chillers, refrigeration, and building systems.
Experience leading and developing engineering teams.
Proven experience managing preventative maintenance programs.
Strong understanding of hotel operations and guest-impacting engineering systems.

new_jobs.title: Chief Engineer, Space
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

We are looking for a Chief Engineer to join our rapidly growing space team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you will serve as the technical lead on a wide berth of emerging developments geared towards high-impact spacecraft missions focused on dynamic space operations, space control, and Rendezvous & Proximity Operations (RPO). Drawing on a strong technical background in space vehicle design, payload design and payload integration, you will drive technology developments through design, build, test, and delivery for on-orbit operations. Anduril is developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our U.S. military and allied partners maintain a decisive advantage in this contested war-fighting domain.

The Chief Engineer will develop a technical strategy and roadmap in conjunction with the Director of Engineering for Space Missions and the Growth/Strategy leads of the Space team that effectively leverages current Anduril technologies and newly developed technologies to serve customer mission areas. This role will address pre-award demonstrations, early contract phases, and full-contract execution. Working with a multi-disciplinary engineering team, the Chief Engineer will ensure the efficient development and delivery of hardware and software solutions for the customer.

These efforts will include leading complex, integrated systems for on-orbit operations and demonstrations to include subcontracted teammates and strategic partnerships. The Chief Engineer will facilitate effective technical development and integration that spans company boundaries in an agile development approach within a continuous integration/continuous deployment paradigm. They will balance the development of new capabilities with the incorporation of pre-existing Anduril or industry capabilities and effectively communicate technical progress to internal and external stakeholders.

The Chief Engineer will be responsible for technical oversight of all aspects of program execution from proposals to SRR, PDR, CDR, MRR, TRR, assembly, qualification testing, and delivery of flight units for launch. In conjunction with the Director of Engineering for Space Missions, they will assist in building out the necessary infrastructure to execute on all aspects of satellite and mission payload build, integration, and test—including establishing test requirements and pass/fail criteria with external vendors. The Chief Engineer will also work closely with the Anduril Space C2 team to enable and deliver Space Ground C2 products to both the customer and broader customer ecosystems. A successful Chief Engineer in the Space business line is one that is technically broad and can serve as an effective technical oversight for all disciplines across all phases of a program lifecycle, including: mechanical, thermal, structural, electrical, orbital software, ground software, FPGA, firmware, GNC, survivability, EMI/EMC, reliability, manufacturing (integration and test), and on-orbit operations.

What You’ll Do

Provide technical leadership and system-level expertise across spacecraft bus subsystems, specialized payload suites, and ground segments.
Serve as the technical authority on the program and maintain the technical integrity of the program. Monitor, control, and execute the engineering baseline of the program, and act in concert with the Program Manager to ensure that technical scope is both appropriate for the mission and satisfies end-customer needs.
Lead technical execution and architecture development for key mission areas, including Space Control and dynamic RPO missions.
Drive the engineering lifecycle for space vehicles and mission payloads from early architecture trades through flight hardware delivery and on-orbit commissioning.
Leverage strategic partnerships and teammates to build out new products that satisfy customer requirements in contested and challenging mission environments.
Provide space industry expertise to refine and advance the Anduril Space portfolio and strategy for customer engagements and demonstrations.
Contribute technical inputs and engineering execution plans to high-priority proposals.
Provide technical mentorship and oversight to a multi-disciplinary engineering team through all phases of program execution up to and including on-orbit operations.
Perform mission- and system-level trade studies and analysis to balance risk, cost, schedule, and mission performance.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated track record architecting, developing, and delivering defense/IC satellite systems, with hands-on heritage in space vehicle design and payload architecture/integration.
Deep domain expertise in Space Domain Awareness (SDA), Space Control, Rendezvous & Proximity Operations (RPO), and dynamic space operations.
Technical familiarity with high-dV spacecraft architectures, closed-loop relative navigation/GNC, and space-based sensing payloads (e.g., optical/IR/RF suites) across multiple orbital regimes (LEO, GEO, cislunar).
Strong understanding of the current technical state, mission needs, and CONOPS of key USSF and IC space enterprise systems.
Demonstrated ability to decompose complex mission requirements with competing constraints (e.g., SWaP-C, performance, schedule, modularity, cybersecurity, MLS) into executable engineering roadmaps.
Experience with standard space qualification and acceptance testing methodologies (e.g., SMC-S-016 / MIL-STD-1540, GEVS).
Strong technical fundamentals across space vehicle bus subsystems, payload interfaces, space ground infrastructure, and rapid product development.
Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to present critical briefings, trade studies, and program milestones to executive leadership and government customers.
Proven technical leadership experience on US Government / DoD / IC space contracts.
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

US Salary Range

$253,000—$336,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:

Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.
